note: BH-9446: a U12 escalation whose record has an unread GitHub input (mergeable_state, checks or changes_requested_open null, or a PR subject with no 40-hex head) waits and is read again on the next tick. After this many ticks in a row with such a record on a repo, the tick makes ONE inputs-unreadable card for the repo (subject source:pr-inputs:<repo>), not one card per PR. A bad value is the code fallback 3.
